frequency_question: How often do advance signals of committee-level bipartisan compromise on energy permitting proceed to enacted law within a two-year legislative window?
membership_rule: Includes major omnibus or standalone energy permitting reform packages that reached committee markup or floor debate; excludes minor non-controversial technical amendments.

cases.name: Waxman-Markey ACES Act (House passed, Senate died)
Manchin Permitting Reform Bill (2022 Senate test votes failed)

coverage_note: 6 named major attempts representing the core population of modern comprehensive permitting reform pushes.
known_gaps: Minor rider provisions attached secretly to must-pass appropriations bills are excluded from this major structural count.
skeleton: Legislative cycles with high polarization and divided/narrow majorities attempting major omnibus permitting overhauls
multiplier: 3 hits out of 6 major structured attempts equals a base rate frequency of 50 percent for advance signals proceeding to enactment.
validity_reason: Valid until the expiration of the current congressional structural alignment and Senate filibuster rules.
